pages.name: Workspace List
pages.purpose: Home page — list all workspaces user belongs to, option to create new

pages.name: Create Workspace
pages.purpose: Create a new workspace with name and description

pages.name: Workspace Dashboard
pages.purpose: Shows workspace details, list of projects, member avatars. Main landing after selecting workspace.

pages.name: Create Project
pages.purpose: Create a new project within a workspace

pages.name: Project Board
pages.purpose: Kanban-style task board for a project. Shows tasks grouped by status (todo, in_progress, done).

pages.name: Task Detail
pages.purpose: Full task view with edit capability. Shows title, description, assignee, due date, status, priority.

pages.name: Workspace Settings
pages.purpose: Manage workspace name, description, and members (add/remove).

navigation.type: responsive: sidebar on desktop (>=768px), bottom tab bar on mobile (<768px), with top status bar
navigation.breadcrumbs: Show on all workspace/project/task pages: Workspace Name > Project Name > Task Title
navigation.mobile_behavior: Sidebar collapses to hamburger menu. Bottom nav has: Home, current Workspace, Profile.

wireframes.layout: Centered card on full-screen gradient background
Full page with top bar (logo + profile avatar) + main grid area
sections: Top bar with app name 'TeamTodo' and user avatar dropdown
Grid of workspace cards (2 cols desktop, 1 col mobile)
Each card: workspace name, description preview, member count avatars, 3-dot menu
Empty state: illustration + text 'No workspaces yet' + CTA button

wireframes.layout: Sidebar/breadcrumbs at top, content area with project list
sections: Workspace header: name, description, member avatars row, settings gear icon
Projects tab: grid of project cards (name, task count, last updated)
Members shown as avatar circles with + Invite button
Floating action button (mobile) to create new project
states: No projects: illustration 'Create your first project'

wireframes.layout: Three-column kanban layout, horizontally scrollable on mobile
sections: Project header: name, back button, task count, filter/search bar
Three columns side-by-side: TODO | IN PROGRESS | DONE
Each column: status header with count, scrollable task card list
Task cards: title, assignee avatar, due date badge, priority indicator (color dot)
Drag-and-drop between columns (desktop), tap to move (mobile)
Column empty state: dotted border + 'No tasks' text
states: Loading: three columns with skeleton cards
Drag active: ghost card, drop target highlight

wireframes.layout: Full-page modal (desktop) or full-screen page (mobile) with form fields
sections: Header: status badge, close/back X button
Save button (top right or bottom sticky)
states: View mode: read-only fields with Edit button
Edit mode: all fields editable, Save/Cancel buttons

sections: Section 1: Workspace Name & Description edit form
Section 2: Members list (table: avatar, name, email, role, Remove button)
Add member: email input + Add button
Danger Zone: Delete Workspace button (with confirmation modal)

key_components.name: Card
key_components.usage: Workspace cards, Project cards, Task cards

key_components.name: Kanban Column
key_components.structure: Header bar (status name + count) + scrollable card list
key_components.scroll: vertical within column, horizontal columns on mobile

key_components.name: Modal
key_components.backdrop: semi-transparent black, click outside to close

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.structure: Centered illustration (SVG) + heading text + description + CTA button

key_changes.mobile: Bottom nav bar, full-width cards, single column kanban (horizontal scroll), hamburger menu
key_changes.desktop: Sidebar nav, multi-column grid, three-column kanban visible side-by-side
